lines.en: My belly drags through the mud.
One sweep of my tail flattens the reeds.

lines.zh: 四条短腿撑起这身重甲。
lines.en: Four short legs carry this armored bulk.
I patrol the swamp's edge.
Every step sinks into soft mud.
This is how a crocodilian walks.
I shift slowly to the water.
Mud slides off my ridged back.
Don't mistake my bulk for slowness.
This Cretaceous swamp is mine.
I move around a dead stump.
I plow a furrow in the bank.
A little further and I can ambush.
I lie on the bank like a log.
Only my eyes show above water.
Waiting is what I do best.
A bird landed on my back.
If I stay still, it forgets me.
Marsh gas bubbles up.
My teeth show outside my jaws.
Water trickles over my claws.
Sun warms my ridged back.
Something is drinking.
You're standing on my bank.
I lift my head; you should back off.
I've been watching you a while.
Human, stay away from the water's edge.

lines.zh: 这条河道不是你洗澡的地方。
lines.en: This channel isn't your bath.
My jaws are wider than your arm.
Did you hear that low growl?
I'm sizing you up.
Either leave, or stay for good.
The pain makes me thrash up a splash.
A white mark shows on my back plates.
I open my jaws and roar.
Blood runs from the corner of my mouth.
I retreat into the water.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我的伏击。
lines.en: That ruined my ambush.
I know this kind of wound.
Thick hide or not, that still stings.

lines.zh: 水里的血腥味引来了我。
lines.en: The smell of blood drew me.
That meat in your hand, toss it here.
I won't chase; I'll just wait.
Smells like fresh meat.
Lower your hand and step back slowly.
That won't fill the gap between my teeth.

lines.zh: 我会为它挪动整个身子。
lines.en: For that I'd move this whole body.
Don't shake; I'm in no hurry.
Put it down, then leave the bank.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从伏击位置撞开。
lines.en: That knocked me out of my ambush spot.
My back plates are hard as stone.
Crowd me again and my jaws open.
Mud splashed all over my face.
My flank hit a root.
You're far too small for this.
Back off; I can't be bothered to move.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的吻部，等于送上门。
lines.en: Hit my snout and you've served yourself up.
Only two of us in this swamp.
I speak to you in low rumbles.
The water is deep; the space is wide.
Tail to tail, we swim slowly.
This is the season to build a nest.
I'll hold this reed bed.
Don't worry; I won't bite you.
Let's bask in the sun together.

lines.zh: 你的背甲花纹和我很像。
lines.en: Your back pattern matches mine.
Swamp mud covers my back.
I can hold this bone.
Drag it into the water to deal with later.
The carrion scraps are mine.
I take it in my jaws and sink.
This will line the nest.
A dead fish counts as a meal.
One bite to test how hard it is.
Don't pick up what's mine.
I can swallow the whole thing.
Bury it in mud and eat later.
The water moved; I've locked on.
That shape on the bank is mine.
Prey has come to the water's edge.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子告诉我它有多重。
lines.en: My snout tells me how heavy it is.
One lunge, just one.
Legs braced, ready.
It stepped into my reach.
Pick the biggest prey.
You won't have time to shout.
The swamp went quiet; perfect.
The mud under you is soft.
When my jaws open, you'll understand.
I follow you along the river.
Only my eyes show, not my body.

lines.zh: 我算着你还有几步到水边。
lines.en: I count your steps to the water.

lines.zh: 你在岸上喘，我在水下等。
lines.en: You pant above; I wait below.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，我就近一尺。
lines.en: Each step you retreat, I gain a foot.
I'll circle downstream to cut you off.

lines.zh: 别盯着水面，我可能在背后。
lines.en: Don't watch the water; I may be behind you.

lines.zh: 我的耐心比你的力气长。
lines.en: My patience outlasts your strength.
The reeds are moving; that's me.
You chose the wrong place to cross.
The splashing covers me.

lines.zh: 你手里的武器举得太高了。
lines.en: Your weapon is held too high.

lines.zh: 泥岸会把你的脚步拖慢。
lines.en: The muddy bank will slow your steps.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，就是为了这一下。
lines.en: My jaws are open for exactly this.
That rumbling you hear is me.
I'm already downstream of you.

lines.zh: 这一片水域我闭着眼都熟。
lines.en: I know these waters blindfolded.

lines.zh: 你转身的速度不如我冲刺。
lines.en: You turn slower than I lunge.
One more step and you're inside my circle.
Got you; don't bother struggling.
The death roll begins.
My teeth are all in your shoulder.
This bite could drag off an ox.
The water bursts; I bear down.
I'm dragging you toward deep water.
My jaws shut with a muffled crunch.
Don't reach out; you'll lose a hand.
Taste a Cretaceous bite.

lines.zh: 我往水下拖，你憋得住吗？
lines.en: I pull you under; can you hold your breath?
I release once, then bite deeper.
Blood reddens the swamp.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住这个角度。
lines.en: Your armor can't stop this angle.

lines.zh: 我把你甩向岸边的石头。
lines.en: I fling you against the bank stones.
Back to the water; I can do it again.
Twenty points of weight comes down.
This struggle only makes it hurt more.
Once I bite, I don't plan to let go.
The swamp has taken you.
I heave up out of the mud.
This channel is wide enough.

lines.zh: 白垩纪的沼泽，气味没变。
lines.en: Cretaceous swamp; the smell hasn't changed.
I shake the mud off my back.
First, find deep water.
The reeds here make good cover.
I open wide to work my jaw.
Who else is in this water?
Good sun; I'll bask a while.
I settle slowly into the water.
This is my new hunting ground.
The bottom mud is soft.

lines.zh: 看看有没有大意的猎物。
lines.en: Let's see if any prey is careless.
Jurassic Reborn; I'm back.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，甲都烫手。
lines.en: Fire caught my back; the plates are hot to touch.
I fell off the bank and crashed into the shallows.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我呛得乱翻。
lines.en: Water floods my throat; I thrash and choke.
The blast rolled my whole body over.

lines.zh: 东西钉进我背上的甲缝。
lines.en: Something lodged between my back plates.

lines.zh: 那股怪力顺着鳞片往骨里钻。
lines.en: That strange force crawls under my scales to the bone.
Hunger leaves me too weak to roll over.

lines.zh: 雷击在我背上，我整条僵住。
lines.en: Lightning struck my back; I went rigid.
The mud beneath me suddenly has no bottom.
